camel_example: aliyun cloudsso AddPermissionPolicyToAccessConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --DirectoryId 'd-00fc2p61****' --PermissionPolicyName AliyunECSFullAccess --PermissionPolicyType System --AccessConfigurationId 'ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****'
description_en: Adds an access policy to an access configuration
description_zh: 为访问配置添加权限策略
name: AddPermissionPolicyToAccessConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access policy. Valid values:

System: system policy. Reuses the system policies of Resource Access Management (RAM).
Inline: inline policy. A custom policy written based on the syntax and structure of RAM policies
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略类型。取值：

System：系统策略。复用RAM的系统策略。
Inline：内置策略。按照RAM权限策略语法和结构编写的自定义策略
parameters.name: permission_policy_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the access policy. 
If PermissionPolicyType is set to System, this parameter specifies the name of the system policy. Because RAM system policies are reused, you must obtain the system policy name from RAM.
If PermissionPolicyType is set to Inline, this parameter specifies the name of the inline policy. You can customize the name. The name can be up to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。具体如下：

当`PermissionPolicyType`为`System`时，该参数为系统策略名称。由于复用的是RAM系统策略，请在RAM中获取系统策略名称。
当`PermissionPolicyType`为`Inline`时，该参数为内置策略名称。您可以自定义该参数。长度最大为32个字符
parameters.name: permission_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The content of the inline policy.

The maximum length is 4,096 characters.

If PermissionPolicyType is set to Inline, this parameter is required. For more information about the syntax and structure of access policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html
parameters.help_zh:
内置策略内容。

长度：最大4096个字符。

当`PermissionPolicyType`为`Inline`时，该参数必须配置。关于权限策略的语法和结构，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html
parameters.name: inline_policy_document
